\\\"order-workflow\\\";\\n    return run(key, () => {\\n        const reservation = step(\\\"reserve\\\", () => reserveStock(key));\\n        if (reservation.kind === \\\"err\\\") {\\n            return Response.json({ error: reservation.error }, { status: 502 });\\n        }\\n        const charge = step(\\\"charge\\\", () => chargeOrder(key, reservation.value));\\n        if (charge.kind === \\\"err\\\") {\\n            return Response.json({ error: charge.error }, { status: 502 });\\n        }\\n        return Response.json({\\n            orderId: key,\\n            reservation: reservation.value,\\n            charge: charge.value,\\n        });\\n    });\\n}\\n\", \"file\": \"handler.ts\"}"}}]},"logprobs":null,"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}],"usage":{"prompt_tokens":34965,"completion_tokens":617,"total_tokens":35582,"prompt_tokens_details":{"cached_tokens":33280},"completion_tokens_details":{"reasoning_tokens":46},"prompt_cache_hit_tokens":33280,"prompt_cache_miss_tokens":1685},"system_fingerprint":"a26a7955944dc5c60445bff77fac9c8e"}
